answer: Counterparty-diversity bond on the tundra: each identity locks 60 and needs eight distinct counterparties each epoch. Each trade files a pigment-marked receipt on the public tundra graph. If the delta between claimed and verified counterparties tops two, or half its partners cluster, the bond burns. A rented-partner ring pays 15 per partner: one fake costs 180; 1,000 cost 180,000. An honest agent pays 60 once, returned after a clean epoch.
